research_question: Do conventional random lead-dropout evaluations predict the diagnostic robustness of 12-lead ECG classifiers under a preregistered library of physically realizable acquisition faults?
directionality: No directional advantage for random dropout or physical faults is presumed.

headers_only: verify 10247 Chapman and 34905 Ningbo valid headers
verify official SHA256 manifest for acquired objects
waveforms_only_after_headers_pass: read Chapman waveforms for nonfinite/malformed count
never access Ningbo waveforms before external confirmation stage
ingestion_gate_before_data_or_model_work.test_environment: install requirements in an isolated project environment and require pytest to pass before training

labels.no_substitution_rule: No label, grouping, threshold, or endpoint changes after Chapman internal-test predictions or any Ningbo model outcome are inspected.

chapman_split.unit: record_id, justified as patient-disjoint by authoritative one-record-per-patient table
chapman_split.algorithm: Deterministic primary-label strata: sort records within the four sinus-bradycardia/sinus-tachycardia bit strata by SHA256(seed + record_id); allocate fixed 70/10/20 counts per stratum, then assign remaining labels by the same hash order. Write membership CSV and SHA256 before model prediction.
chapman_split.sealed: Internal-test labels may be used only after model/training/fault/threshold selection is frozen.

preprocessing.display_reconstruction: derive III, aVR, aVL, aVF from I and II using unit-tested standard equations

availability.random_control: same number k of unavailable independent signals, evaluated separately per random draw; reconstruct complete display representation from retained independent signals only where algebraically identifiable
availability.primary_endpoint: class-specific AUPRC degradation physical minus matched-random degradation

connection_errors.control: clean performance; no dropout or other reversal is called a random control
primary_endpoints: Spearman correlation of model/class robustness ranks under random dropout versus each reversal

bootstrap.random_rule: within each resample, compute every random-mask metric separately then average metrics; never average predictions

statistics.reporting: source-specific first; no pooling Chapman and Ningbo

go_scope: GO authorizes only the stated Chapman one-architecture/one-seed failure-analysis pilot after ingestion gates pass. It does not authorize training now, changes to historical v1 evidence, new augmentation experiments, or Ningbo inference.
